name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-project-health-check
title: Project Health Check
shortDescription: Assesses SharePoint project health and optionally creates a standalone HTML management report.
longDescription: Analyzes project documents and structured SharePoint project registers to determine GREEN, AMBER, RED, or UNKNOWN health across schedule, risks, actions, decisions and dependencies, and documentation and governance.

The skill is evidence-driven, distinguishes overdue work from forecast variance, evaluates future deliverables in context, highlights management attention, and can create a self-contained HTML5 report for direct browser viewing.
